title: Securing quality in every dose: 5 essential capabilities for CGT developers to look for in a fill-finish CDMO
summary: With their promise to transform disease trajectories, cell and gene therapies (CGTs) are bringing new hope to patients with an ever-expanding array of high-burden and chronic conditions as well as rare genetic disorders.

title: Breast Cancer Cells Achieve Stress Resistance by Transcription Molecular Switch
summary: Acetylation and deacetylation of MED1, a key subunit during transcription, acts as a regulatory switch that helps cancer cells reprogram gene expression in response to stress, supporting both survival and growth.The postBreast Cancer Cells Achieve Stress Resistance by Transcription Molecular Switchappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.

title: Solid Biosciences Licenses Use of Next-Generation Capsid AAV-SLB101 to Andelyn Biosciences
summary: Solid grants Andelyn a non-exclusive worldwide license to provide its gene therapy clients with access to utilize AAV-SLB101 in combination with Andelyn’s suspension and adherent modular platform process—AAV Curator.The postSolid Biosciences Licenses Use of Next-Generation Capsid AAV-SLB101 to Andelyn Biosciencesappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.

title: Attention-Improving Gene in Mice Could Inform Calming ADHD Therapies
summary: Study showed that theHomer1gene plays a role in shaping attention in mice, with animals carrying specific variants experiencing quieter brain activity and improved ability to focus, which has implications for ADHD and related disorders.The postAttention-Improving Gene in Mice Could Inform Calming ADHD Therapiesappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.

title: Ocugen posts midphase gene therapy data, charting course for rivalry with Apellis, Astellas
summary: Ocugen has reported preliminary phase 2 data on its eye disease gene therapy, providing more evidence that the candidate may outperform existing treatments from Apellis and Astellas.

title: Oxford Biomedica confirms takeover talks with biotech investor EQT
summary: Oxford, major contract manufacturer to cell and gene therapy companies, has already rejected multiple, unsolicited take-private bids from EQT that it felt “undervalued” the company and its prospects.
